description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for animations and layout management in a booking UI, including framer-motion animation configs, layout-specific size classes, and a resize animation hook.

methods.name: getBookerSizeClassNames
methods.description: Generates class names for sizing based on layout, state, and visibility options.

methods.name: useBookerResizeAnimation
methods.description: Custom React hook that animates the size of the booking component based on layout and state, respecting user motion preferences.
